cases.name: stale-default
cases.description: Function default parameter updated from 30 to 60, but documentation still states 30.

cases.name: parameter-added
cases.description: New parameter 'retries' added to function signature; documentation omits it.

cases.name: removed-symbol
cases.description: Function 'old_login' removed; tutorial documentation still instructs users to call it.

cases.name: renamed-flag
cases.description: CLI flag '--timeout' renamed to '--request-timeout'; configuration table still lists old flag.

cases.name: no-doc-impact
cases.description: Internal refactoring and private variable rename with zero effect on public documentation.

cases.name: docs-fixed-same-pr
cases.description: Code default and documentation both updated simultaneously within the same pull request.

cases.name: ambiguous-runtime
cases.description: Dynamic attribute routing via getattr/runtime reflection with ambiguous static signals.

cases.name: historical-fix
cases.description: Historical evaluation: code changed in commit N, docs fixed in commit N+1. Pre-fix state detected as drift.
